Behind him, shelves are stocked with various colorful snack packages, and a refrigerated section with glass doors is visible on the left. (2) The camera focuses on a close-up of the snack bag, showing the coffee bean and cup illustrations. The man’s hand is seen gripping the top of the bag. (3) The setting shifts to a simpler indoor environment with a dark door frame in the background. The man opens the bag, leans his face toward it to smell the aroma, and pulls out a single triangular corn chip coated in dark seasoning. (4) He bites into the chip, his facial expressions shifting from curiosity to a mix of surprise and contemplation while looking directly at the camera. He continues talking while holding the bag up, ending with a smile and a pointing gesture.
